topic: Someone finds out their best friend is moving across the country
text: The rain's been sluicing down all night, just like my mood. Found out my so-called best friend's packing up, hopping a train to who-knows-where. Never said a word, didn’t even hint at it. Maybe they figured I wouldn’t notice. Or care. Well, I did. I noticed. This city makes everyone tight-lipped, but that doesn’t mean you cut ties without a fight. I’ll have my say before they grab that last suitcase and walk out. Don’t know what I’ll say, but it’ll be the last thing I’ve got left to give 'em. Rain or shine, they’re not getting off that easy.
